name: HIA Core-only
on: [push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch]
jobs:
  source:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14.4'
      - name: Regenerate actual HIA sources
        run: |
          set -eu
          for component in core_workspace_pipeline core_workspace_facts core_workspace_facts_cli core_workspace_materialize core_workspace_cli capability_renaming core_module_graph core_workspace_json core_workspace_json_cli agent_identity agent_slice elf_linker native_filter core_json_cli agent_stdio agent_snapshot agent_snapshot_json agent_snapshot_json_cli sha256_stream native_observer sha256 json_preflight json_decode json_canonical core_json_frontend selfhost agent_binary64 agent_data_json instruction_policy program_shape function_shape artifact_publication core_admission_cli core_admission agent_binary64_format core_patch core_patch_cli core_patch_result_cli composite_types task_helpers composite_functions composite_constructor composite_outer worker_request release_install agent_journal json_wire worker_report machine_plan linked_observer machine_encoding cli_control cli_format agent_store_authority artifact_page machine_state machine_instructions machine_elf core_lowering bounded_read core_unpack; do
            python -B -m "tools.generate_hia_$component"
          done
          python -B tools/generate_hia_selfhost_contract.py
          python -B tests/test_hia_selfhost_language_coverage.py --generate-inventory
          python -B tools/generate_hia_selfhost_contract.py
          python -B tools/generate_hia_selfhost_contract.py --check
          git diff --exit-code
      - run: python -B tools/check_hia_core_only.py
      - run: python -B tools/generate_hia_selfhost_contract.py --check
      - run: python -B tests/test_hia_selfhost_language_coverage.py --generate-inventory
      - run: git diff --exit-code
      - name: Core source and independent reference controls
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PY'
          import unittest
          names = (
              'tests.test_hia_core_only',
              'tests.test_hia_evidence_archive',
              'tests.test_hia_core_workspace_facts_native.CoreWorkspaceFactsSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_workspace_materialize_native.CoreWorkspaceMaterializerSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_string_accounting',
              'tests.test_hia_structure_traversal',
              'tests.test_hia_capability_renaming_native.CapabilityRenamingSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_module_graph_native.CoreModuleGraphSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_source_head_identity',
              'tests.test_hia_integrated_workflow',
              'tests.test_hia_core_workspace_json_native.CoreWorkspaceJsonSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_workspace_json_cli.CoreWorkspaceJsonCliSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_workspace_pipeline.CoreWorkspacePipelineSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_identity_native.AgentIdentitySourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_slice_native.AgentSliceSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_installed_resources.AgentInstalledResourceSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_bounded_read_source.BoundedReadSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_stdio.AgentStdioSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_snapshot_native.AgentSnapshotSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_snapshot_json_native.AgentSnapshotJsonSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_entry',
              'tests.test_hia_elf_linker.ElfLinkerSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_json_cli.CoreJsonCliSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_word_io.WordIOSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_emitter_words.EmitterSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_sha256_stream_native.Sha256StreamSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_sha256_native.Sha256HiaSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_json_preflight',
              'tests.test_hia_json_preflight_native.JsonPreflightHiaSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_json_decode_native.JsonDecodeHiaSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_json_canonical_native.JsonCanonicalHiaSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_exports.ExportSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_json_frontend_native.CoreJsonFrontendHiaSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost.SelfhostSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_contract.SelfhostContractTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_cli',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_names',
              'tests.test_hia_reference_fixture_efficiency',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_returned_loans',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_multi_results.SelfhostMultiResultSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_keywords.SelfhostKeywordTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_signed.SelfhostSignedTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_traps.SelfhostExplicitTrapTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_language_coverage.SelfhostLanguageSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_data_json_native.AgentDataJsonSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_binary64_native.AgentBinary64SourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_instruction_policy_native.InstructionPolicySourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_program_shape_native.ProgramShapeSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_function_shape_native.FunctionShapeSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_artifact_publication_native.ArtifactPublicationPolicyTests',
              'tests.test_hia_artifact_publication_route.PublicationRouteSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_publication_custody_ingress.PublicationColdCustodyIngressTests',
              'tests.test_hia_publication_custody_observer.PublicationCustodyObserverTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_admission_native.CoreAdmissionSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_admission_cli.CoreAdmissionCliSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_patch_native.CorePatchSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_patch_cli.CorePatchCliSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_patch_result_cli.CorePatchResultCliSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_patch_result_cli.CorePatchResultCliAdapterTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_types_native.CompositeTypesSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_types_native.CompositeTypesAdapterTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_origins_native.CompositeOriginsAdapterTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_signatures_native.CompositeSignaturesAdapterTests',
              'tests.test_hia_task_helpers_native.TaskHelpersSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_task_helpers_native.TaskHelpersAdapterTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_native_composition.SourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_functions_native.FunctionSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_function_tokens.TokenCodecTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_function_protocol_audit.FunctionTokenProtocolAuditTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_constructor_source.ConstructorSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_constructor_native.ConstructorFrameTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_outer_source.OuterSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_outer_native.OuterFrameTests',
              'tests.test_hia_native_builder_source_binding',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_binary64_format_native.AgentBinary64FormatSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_artifact_store_native.AgentArtifactStorePolicyTests',
              'tests.test_hia_worker_request_native.WorkerRequestSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_release_install.ReleaseInstallerSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_journal_native.JournalSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_json_wire_native.WireSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_worker_report_native.WorkerReportSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_machine_plan_native.MachinePlanSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_machine_encoding_native.MachineEncodingSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_cli_native.CliSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_linked_observer.LinkedObserverSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_store_authority_native.StoreAuthoritySourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_artifact_read_native.ArtifactReadSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_store_page_gates',
              'tests.test_hia_machine_state_native.MachineStateSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_machine_instructions_native.MachineInstructionsSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_machine_elf_native.MachineElfSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_lowering_native.CoreLoweringSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_unpack_native.UnpackCompositionSourceTests',
              'tests.test_hia_core_unpack_gates',
              'tests.test_hia_core_unpack_progress.UnpackQualificationProgressTests',
              'tests.test_hia_compiler_owner_gates',
          )
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names))
          raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures else 1)
          PY
  native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14.4'
      - name: Install qualified Clang 20 native execution prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key
          fingerprint=$(gpg --show-keys --with-colons "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10; exit }')
          test "$fingerprint" = 6084F3CF814B57C1CF12EFD515CF4D18AF4F7421
          sudo install -m 0644 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" /usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc
          printf '%s\n' 'deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc] https://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-20 main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hia-llvm20.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y binutils gcc clang-20 libclang-rt-20-dev strace
          printf 'CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\nHEPTA_CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\n' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: python -m pip install setuptools==78.1.1 wheel==0.46.3 z3-solver==4.15.4.0 jsonschema==4.26.0
      - run: python -B tools/replay_hia_selfhost_cold.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json"
      - run: python -B tests/test_hia_selfhost_language_coverage.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-language.json"
      - name: Matching-cold bounded read and original public callers
        run: |
          python -B -m tools.qualify_hia_bounded_read \
            --compiler "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.cold/qualification.evidence/B3.image.bin" \
            --cold-report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-bounded-read"
      - name: Native applications and actual Core memory controls
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYTEST'
          import unittest
          names = (
              'tests.test_hia_agent_stdio',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_snapshot_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_snapshot_json_native',
              'tests.test_hia_core_json_cli',
              'tests.test_hia_elf_linker',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_identity_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_slice_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_installed_resources',
              'tests.test_hia_native_child_limits',
              'tests.test_hia_native_seccomp',
              'tests.test_hia_native_side_effects',
              'tests.test_hia_native_cleanup',
              'tests.test_hia_native_mapping_identity',
              'tests.test_hia_native_startup_isolation',
              'tests.test_hia_json_preflight_native',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_emitter_words',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_admission_transaction',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_borrow_admission',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_borrow_rollback_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_completed_pin_retirement',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_finalization_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_job_identity',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_lease_authority',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_lease_identity_collision',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_lease_mprotect_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_lease_token_revocation',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_owner_registry_identity',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_owner_retirement',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_prestart_admission',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_prestart_pin_release_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_prestart_retirement_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_public_release_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_quarantine_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_race',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_mprotect_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_snapshot',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_recovery_zero_fault',
              'tests.test_hia_host_region_write_receipt',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_data_json_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_binary64_native',
              'tests.test_hia_agent_binary64_format_native',
          )
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names))
          raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures else 1)
          PYTEST
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_AGENT_STDIO_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native Core module graph and actual workspace projects
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_module_graph_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_MODULE_GRAPH_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_MODULE_GRAPH_OBSERVATIONS: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-module-projects
      - name: Native Core workspace JSON materialization and actual ABI
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_workspace_json_native tests.test_hia_core_workspace_json_cli tests.test_hia_core_workspace_pipeline -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_MODULE_GRAPH_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native Core capability edge policy and actual CFG
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_capability_renaming_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CAPABILITY_RENAMING_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native explicit workspace facts and semantic ELF materialization
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_workspace_facts_native tests.test_hia_core_workspace_materialize_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_MODULE_GRAPH_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native full Core function declarations SSA and CFG
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_function_shape_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_FUNCTION_SHAPE_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native whole primitive Core declaration SSA CFG and export admission
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_program_shape_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_PROGRAM_SHAPE_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native complete local instruction policy
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_instruction_policy_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_INSTRUCTION_POLICY_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native exact-byte artifact publication and real kernel races
        run: python -B -m tools.qualify_hia_artifact_publication_tests run --retain-evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-artifact-publication"
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Preserve original artifact publication fixtures and call records
        if: always()
        run: python -B -m tools.qualify_hia_artifact_publication_tests archive --retain-evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-artifact-publication" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-artifact-publication-custody"
      - name: Native whole primitive Core admission and body resource flow
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_admission_native -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_ADMISSION_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Standalone native complete Core admission CLI
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_admission_cli -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_ADMISSION_CLI_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native snapshot-bound edits and complete Core patch CLI
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_core_patch_native tests.test_hia_core_patch_cli -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_PATCH_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_PATCH_CLI_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native ordinary Agent candidate bytes diagnostics and real crash cuts
        run: python -B -m unittest tests.test_hia_agent_candidate_native tests.test_hia_core_patch_result_cli -v
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_PATCH_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_PATCH_RESULT_CLI_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native complete nominal types helpers constructor functions and outer lowering
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYTYPES'
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames((
              'tests.test_hia_composite_types_native',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_origins_native',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_signatures_native',
              'tests.test_hia_task_helpers_native',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_native_composition',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_function_tokens',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_function_admission',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_function_protocol_audit',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_function_terms_native',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_functions_native',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_public_lifecycle',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_constructor_native',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_constructor_integration',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_outer_native',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_outer_integration',
              'tests.test_hia_composite_nominal_lifecycle'))
          expected = suite.countTestCases()
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          complete = result.testsRun == expected and expected > 0
          clean = not (result.errors or result.failures or result.skipped or
                       result.expectedFailures or result.unexpectedSuccesses)
          raise SystemExit(0 if complete and clean and result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
          PYTYPES
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_COMPOSITE_TYPES_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_TASK_HELPERS_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_COMPOSITE_FUNCTIONS_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_COMPOSITE_CONSTRUCTOR_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_COMPOSITE_OUTER_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_COMPOSITE_FIXTURE_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-nominal-fixture
      - name: Native worker request admission and ordinary request continuity
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYREQUEST'
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames((
              'tests.test_hia_worker_request_native',
              'tests.test_hia_worker_request_review',
          ))
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures else 1)
          PYREQUEST
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_WORKER_REQUEST_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native request journal decisions and actual SQL crash controls
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYJOURNAL'
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.test_hia_agent_journal_native')
          expected = suite.countTestCases()
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          complete = result.testsRun == expected and expected > 0
          clean = not (result.errors or result.failures or result.skipped or
                       result.expectedFailures or result.unexpectedSuccesses)
          raise SystemExit(0 if complete and clean and result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
          PYJOURNAL
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_AGENT_JOURNAL_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Ordinary Agent callers with native journal and retained owner forbidden
        run: |
          python -B tools/qualify_hia_agent_journal_callers.py \
            --cold-report "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-journal-callers.json" \
            --module tests.test_hia_agent_native_tools \
            --module tests.test_hia_agent_native_proof_contract \
            --module tests.test_hia_agent_native_lease_snapshot \
            --module tests.test_hia_agent_native_machine_choices \
            --module tests.test_hia_agent_native_campaign \
            --module tests.test_hia_agent_candidate_native \
            --module tests.test_hia_worker_request_native \
            --module tests.test_hia_worker_request_review
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_PATCH_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_CORE_PATCH_RESULT_CLI_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_WORKER_REQUEST_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
      - name: Native immutable release installation and recovery observations
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYINSTALL'
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.test_hia_release_install')
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures else 1)
          PYINSTALL
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_RELEASE_INSTALL_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_RELEASE_INSTALL_OBSERVATIONS: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-release-install
      - name: Native graph wire worker machine-plan and linked observer
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYNATIVEOWNERS'
          import json, os, unittest
          from pathlib import Path
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames((
              'tests.test_hia_json_wire_native',
              'tests.test_hia_json_wire_cache',
              'tests.test_hia_json_wire_entry',
              'tests.test_hia_worker_report_native',
              'tests.test_hia_machine_plan_native',
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_linked_observer',
              'tests.test_hia_cli_native',
          ))
          def flatten(suite):
              for item in suite:
                  if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite):
                      yield from flatten(item)
                  else:
                      yield item
          loaded = [test.id() for test in flatten(suite)]
          executed = []
          class Result(unittest.TextTestResult):
              def startTest(self, test):
                  executed.append(test.id())
                  super().startTest(test)
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2, resultclass=Result).run(suite)
          anomalies = {name: [str(item) for item in getattr(result, name)] for name in (
              'errors', 'failures', 'skipped', 'expectedFailures', 'unexpectedSuccesses')}
          passed = (bool(loaded) and loaded == executed and result.testsRun == len(loaded)
                    and not any(anomalies.values()) and result.wasSuccessful())
          report = {'schema': 'hepta.hia.native-component-tests.v1',
              'scope': 'CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD_SELECTED_COMPONENTS',
              'status': 'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL_OR_INCOMPLETE',
              'loaded_test_ids': loaded, 'executed_test_ids': executed,
              'tests_run': result.testsRun, 'anomalies': anomalies,
              'default_activation_or_whole_stack_claimed': False}
          Path(os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_NATIVE_COMPONENT_REPORT']).write_text(
              json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)
          PYNATIVEOWNERS

"""Finite source/IO controls for the explicit publication evidence observer.

These controls do not compile HIA, run a publication application, execute the
original 39 methods, or change their poison/limits.  The two small child uses
are ordinary process-record controls with their own explicit 3 second bounds.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import hia_artifact_publication_custody as custody
from tools import qualify_hia_artifact_publication_tests as qualifier


class _FailedResult:
    testsRun = 0

    @staticmethod
    def wasSuccessful():
        return False


class PublicationCustodyObserverTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        retained = os.environ.get('HEPTA_PUBLICATION_OBSERVER_CONTROL_RETAIN')
        if retained:
            # Explicit source-control custody only.  Normal discovery keeps
            # ordinary TemporaryDirectory cleanup; product tests are untouched.
            self.folder = None
            self.root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='hia-publication-observer-control-', dir=retained))
        else:
            self.folder = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-publication-observer-control-')
            self.addCleanup(self.folder.cleanup)
            self.root = Path(self.folder.name)
        self.session = custody.Session(self.root / 'records')
        self.session.test_id = self.id()
        self.executable = self.root / 'control-executable'
        # This file is retained by preflight-only controls, not executed.
        self.executable.write_bytes(b'CONTROL-ONLY-NOT-A-PRODUCT-IMAGE\n')
        self.argv = [str(self.executable), 'store-hash', str(self.root), 'a' * 64]

    def call(self, wire=b'complete offered input', **kwargs):
        return custody._Call(self.session, self.argv, wire, 3,
                             'finite observer control only', {'capture_output': True, **kwargs})

    def hold(self):
        record = self.session.finish(_FailedResult())
        self.assertEqual(record['status'], 'TESTS_FAIL_OR_CUSTODY_HOLD')
        actual, _ = custody.read_file(self.session.root / 'RUN.json')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(actual), record)
        return record

    def incomplete(self, stage):
        self.assertEqual(len(self.session.calls), 1)
        call = self.session.calls[0]
        row = call.summary()
        self.assertEqual(row['test_id'], self.id())
        self.assertFalse(row['launch_attempted'])
        self.assertFalse(row['launch_completed'])
        self.assertIsNone(row['process'])
        self.assertEqual(row['preflight']['stage'], stage)
        self.assertFalse(row['preflight']['complete'])
        self.assertEqual(row['preflight']['error']['stage'], stage)
        self.assertTrue(row['record_errors'])
        self.assertTrue(custody.direct_child_custody_closed(row))
        return call, row

    def test_evidence_fsync_is_bound_while_shared_product_poison_remains_effective(self):
        actual = custody._EVIDENCE_FSYNC
        observed = []

        def record(fd):
            observed.append(os.fstat(fd).st_mode)
            return actual(fd)

        with patch.object(custody, '_EVIDENCE_FSYNC', side_effect=record), \
                patch.object(os, 'fsync', side_effect=AssertionError('host artifact fsync')) as poison:
            result = custody.write_new(self.root / 'evidence.bin', b'\0evidence\xff')
            self.assertEqual((self.root / 'evidence.bin').read_bytes(), b'\0evidence\xff')
            self.assertEqual(result['sha256'], sha256(b'\0evidence\xff').hexdigest())
            self.assertEqual(len(observed), 2)  # actual file and parent durability
            poison.assert_not_called()
            fd = os.open(self.root / 'evidence.bin', os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, 'host artifact fsync'):
                    os.fsync(fd)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
            self.assertEqual(poison.call_count, 1)

    def test_complete_call_preflight_preserves_request_under_original_shared_poison(self):
        wire = b'\0independent offered payload\xff'
        with patch.object(os, 'fsync', side_effect=AssertionError('host artifact fsync')) as poison:
            call = self.call(wire)
            poison.assert_not_called()
        row = call.summary()
        self.assertEqual(row['preflight']['stage'], 'READY')
        self.assertTrue(row['preflight']['complete'])
        self.assertTrue(row['preflight']['request_written'])
        self.assertIsNone(row['preflight']['error'])
        self.assertEqual((call.root / 'stdin.offered.bin').read_bytes(), wire)
        self.assertEqual((call.root / 'executable.bin').read_bytes(), self.executable.read_bytes())
        request = json.loads((call.root / 'request.json').read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(request, call.request)
        self.assertEqual(request['timeout'], 3)
        self.assertEqual(request['argv'], self.argv)
        self.assertFalse(row['launch_attempted'])

    def test_sealed_descriptor_preflight_uses_same_durability_binding(self):
        fd = os.memfd_create('observer-control', os.MFD_CLOEXEC)
        try:
            data = b'raw descriptor control; never executed'
            os.write(fd, data)
            self.argv[0] = '/proc/self/fd/' + str(fd)
            with patch.object(os, 'fsync', side_effect=AssertionError('host artifact fsync')) as poison:
                call = self.call(pass_fds=(fd,))
                poison.assert_not_called()
            self.assertEqual((call.root / 'executable.bin').read_bytes(), data)
            self.assertEqual(call.request['executable_original_identity'], custody.identity(os.fstat(fd)))
            self.assertEqual(call.request['pass_fds'], [fd])
        finally:
            os.close(fd)

    def test_invalid_wire_retains_initialized_call_and_run_failure(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(TypeError, 'exact bytes'):
            self.call(bytearray(b'invalid wire type'))
        call, row = self.incomplete('ARGUMENTS')
        self.assertIsNone(call.request)
        self.assertIsNone(row['preflight']['stdin'])
        self.assertFalse((call.root / 'request.json').exists())
        record = self.hold()
        self.assertEqual(record['calls'][0]['preflight']['error']['type'], 'TypeError')
        self.assertEqual(record['tests_run'], 0)

    def test_existing_call_directory_failure_is_not_erased_by_summary(self):
        (self.session.root / 'calls' / '00000').mkdir(mode=0o700)
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            self.call()
        call, row = self.incomplete('DIRECTORY')
        self.assertFalse(row['preflight']['root_created'])
        self.assertIsNone(call.request)
        self.hold()

    def test_missing_executable_retains_complete_offered_stdin(self):
        self.executable.unlink()
        with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
            self.call(b'full bytes before executable failure')
        call, row = self.incomplete('EXECUTABLE_READ')
        self.assertEqual((call.root / 'stdin.offered.bin').read_bytes(), b'full bytes before executable failure')
        self.assertIsNotNone(row['preflight']['stdin'])
        self.assertIsNone(row['preflight']['executable'])
        self.hold()

    def test_symlink_executable_is_still_refused_and_original_link_unchanged(self):
        linked = self.root / 'linked-executable'
        linked.symlink_to(self.executable.name)
        self.argv[0] = str(linked)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.call()
        self.incomplete('EXECUTABLE_READ')
        self.assertTrue(linked.is_symlink())
        self.hold()

    def test_real_custody_fsync_failure_retains_partial_stdin_and_holds(self):
        wire = b'actual write before injected observer fsync failure'
        with patch.object(custody, '_EVIDENCE_FSYNC', side_effect=OSError('observer durability failure')):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, 'observer durability failure'):
                self.call(wire)
        call, row = self.incomplete('STDIN')
        self.assertEqual((call.root / 'stdin.offered.bin').read_bytes(), wire)
        self.assertIsNone(row['preflight']['stdin'])  # no false durable receipt
        self.assertIsNone(call.request)
        self.hold()

    def test_partial_executable_write_preserves_both_originals_and_error_stage(self):
        original = custody.write_new

        def fail(path, data):
            if Path(path).name == 'executable.bin':
                original(path, data[:7])
                raise OSError('partial executable custody')
            return original(path, data)

        with patch.object(custody, 'write_new', side_effect=fail):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, 'partial executable custody'):
                self.call(b'stdin survives')
        call, row = self.incomplete('EXECUTABLE_WRITE')
        self.assertEqual((call.root / 'stdin.offered.bin').read_bytes(), b'stdin survives')
        self.assertEqual((call.root / 'executable.bin').read_bytes(), self.executable.read_bytes()[:7])
        self.assertIsNone(row['preflight']['executable'])
        self.hold()

    def test_partial_request_is_preserved_without_claiming_it_was_written(self):
        original = custody.write_json

        def fail(path, value):
            if Path(path).name == 'request.json':
                custody.write_new(path, b'{"partial":')
                raise OSError('partial request custody')
            return original(path, value)

        with patch.object(custody, 'write_json', side_effect=fail):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, 'partial request custody'):
                self.call()
        call, row = self.incomplete('REQUEST_WRITE')
        self.assertEqual((call.root / 'request.json').read_bytes(), b'{"partial":')
        self.assertFalse(row['preflight']['request_written'])
        self.assertEqual(row['preflight']['unwritten_request_data'], call.request)
        self.hold()
        quiet = qualifier.quiescence(self.session.root)
        self.assertEqual([r['ordinal'] for r in quiet['incomplete_preflight_requests']], [0])
        self.assertFalse(quiet['ready_for_fixture_read'])  # actual runner still alive

    def test_quiescence_does_not_parse_absent_unlaunched_request(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.call(bytearray())
        call, _ = self.incomplete('ARGUMENTS')
        self.hold()
        self.assertFalse((call.root / 'request.json').exists())
        quiet = qualifier.quiescence(self.session.root)
        self.assertEqual(quiet['not_observed_reaped'], [])
        self.assertEqual(len(quiet['incomplete_preflight_requests']), 1)
        self.assertFalse(quiet['ready_for_fixture_read'])

    def test_quiescence_never_treats_launched_partial_record_as_unlaunched(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.call(bytearray())
        record = self.hold()
        record['calls'][0]['launch_attempted'] = True
        (self.session.root / 'RUN.json').write_text(json.dumps(record))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'not proven unlaunched'):
            qualifier.quiescence(self.session.root)

    def test_quiescence_rejects_boolean_shape_corruption(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.call(bytearray())
        record = self.hold()
        record['calls'][0]['preflight']['complete'] = 0
        (self.session.root / 'RUN.json').write_text(json.dumps(record))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'shape'):
            qualifier.quiescence(self.session.root)

    def test_completed_preflight_missing_request_is_not_silently_skipped(self):
        call = self.call()
        self.hold()
        (call.root / 'request.json').unlink()
        with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
            qualifier.quiescence(self.session.root)

    def test_real_exited_preflight_runner_allows_failed_originals_custody_only(self):
        destination = self.root / 'child-records'
        source = Path(custody.__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        script = (
            'import sys;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);'
            'from pathlib import Path;'
            'from tools import hia_artifact_publication_custody as c;'
            'from tools import qualify_hia_artifact_publication_tests as q;'
            'import unittest;'
            '\nclass T(unittest.TestCase):'
            '\n def id(self):return "SOURCE_CONTROL_ONLY.PREFLIGHT_FAILURE"'
            '\n def runTest(self):c._Call(c._ACTIVE,[sys.argv[3],"store-hash",sys.argv[2],"a"*64],bytearray(),3,"source control only",{})'
            '\nq.MODULES=("SOURCE_CONTROL_ONLY",)'
            '\nq.ORIGINAL_TEST_IDS=("SOURCE_CONTROL_ONLY.PREFLIGHT_FAILURE",)'
            '\nq.source_snapshot=lambda:{"scope":"synthetic source-control runner only"}'
            '\nq.copy_inputs=lambda session:{"original39_executed":False,"native_executed":False}'
            '\nq.unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames=lambda names:unittest.TestSuite([T()])'
            '\nraise SystemExit(q.run_tests(sys.argv[2]))\n'
        )
        completed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', '-c', script,
                                    str(source), str(destination), str(self.executable)],
                                   capture_output=True, timeout=3)
        self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(completed.stdout)['status'], 'HOLD')
        self.assertIn(b'TypeError: test native stdin must be exact bytes', completed.stderr)
        custody.write_new(self.root / 'synthetic-runner.stdout.log', completed.stdout)
        custody.write_new(self.root / 'synthetic-runner.stderr.log', completed.stderr)
        record = json.loads((destination / 'RUN.json').read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(record['status'], 'TESTS_FAIL_OR_CUSTODY_HOLD')
        self.assertEqual(record['tests_run'], 1)
        report = json.loads((destination / 'REPORT.json').read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(report['status'], 'HOLD')
        self.assertEqual(report['expected_test_ids'], ['SOURCE_CONTROL_ONLY.PREFLIGHT_FAILURE'])
        self.assertEqual(report['anomalies']['errors'], 1)
        self.assertNotIn('failure', report)  # the original case error was not replaced by finalizer failure
        quiet = qualifier.quiescence(destination)
        self.assertTrue(quiet['ready_for_fixture_read'])
        self.assertEqual(len(quiet['incomplete_preflight_requests']), 1)
        self.assertFalse(quiet['full_process_tree_cleanup_claimed'])
        archive = self.root / 'actual-archive'
        self.assertEqual(qualifier.archive_evidence(destination, archive), 0)
        manifest = json.loads((archive / 'TYPED-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes())
        archive_report = json.loads((archive / 'ARCHIVE.json').read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(archive_report['status'], 'CLOSED_ORIGINAL_FIXTURES_RETAINED')
        self.assertFalse(archive_report['test_result_reclassified'])
        with tarfile.open(archive / 'publication-originals.tar.gz', 'r:gz') as stream:
            names = {member.name for member in stream}
        self.assertTrue(any(name.endswith('/REPORT.json') for name in names))
        self.assertTrue(any(name.endswith('/RUN.json') for name in names))
        self.assertEqual(archive_report['typed_members'], len(manifest))
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((destination / 'REPORT.json').read_bytes())['status'], 'HOLD')

    def test_real_control_child_is_observed_under_poison_without_disabling_product_poison(self):
        self.executable.write_bytes(b'#!/bin/sh\nprintf "observer-control-only\\n"\n')
        self.executable.chmod(0o700)
        with patch.object(os, 'fsync', side_effect=AssertionError('host artifact fsync')) as poison:
            completed = self.session.run(self.argv, input=b'control stdin', capture_output=True, timeout=3)
            poison.assert_not_called()
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, 'host artifact fsync'):
                os.fsync(0)
        self.assertEqual((completed.returncode, completed.stdout, completed.stderr),
                         (0, b'observer-control-only\n', b''))
        call = self.session.calls[0]
        self.assertTrue(custody.direct_child_custody_closed(call.summary()))
        record = self.hold()  # a source-control child is never a product PASS
        self.assertEqual(record['tests_run'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(record['calls'][0]['returncode'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(call.request['timeout'], 3)
        returned = [r for r in call.events if r['kind'] == 'COMMUNICATE_RETURN']
        self.assertEqual(len(returned), 1)
        out = returned[0]['stdout']
        self.assertEqual(Path(out['path']).read_bytes(), completed.stdout)

"""Opt-in evidence for the original artifact-publication tests.

This module changes no native policy, timeout, input or process termination
decision.  The test runner installs the observer explicitly.  Ordinary unittest
execution still uses TemporaryDirectory and Popen directly.  Offered stdin is
retained before launch; it is not a claim that a failed child consumed it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import contextmanager
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import traceback


OPERATIONS = frozenset(('publish', 'verify', 'withdraw', 'store-put', 'store-get', 'store-hash'))
_REAL_RUN = subprocess.run
_REAL_POPEN = subprocess.Popen
# Evidence durability belongs to this explicit observer.  The original tests
# poison the shared os.fsync attribute to forbid hosted product publication;
# that poison must remain effective for the product, while observer records
# still use the genuine primitive captured before the tests are installed.
_EVIDENCE_FSYNC = os.fsync
_ACTIVE = None


def identity(value):
    return {name: getattr(value, 'st_' + name) for name in
            ('dev', 'ino', 'mode', 'nlink', 'uid', 'gid', 'size', 'mtime_ns', 'ctime_ns')}


@contextmanager
def parent_fd(path):
    """Hold and recheck every directory link; never traverse a symlink."""
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in path.parts[1:]):
        raise ValueError('absolute ordinary path required')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC
    fds = [os.open('/', flags)]
    links = []
    try:
        for part in path.parts[1:-1]:
            before = os.stat(part, dir_fd=fds[-1], follow_symlinks=False)
            child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=fds[-1])
            fds.append(child)
            observed = os.fstat(child)
            if (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_mode) != (observed.st_dev, observed.st_ino, observed.st_mode):
                raise ValueError('parent directory changed while opening')
            links.append((part, before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_mode))
        yield fds[-1], path.name
        for index, (part, dev, ino, mode) in enumerate(links):
            linked = os.stat(part, dir_fd=fds[index], follow_symlinks=False)
            held = os.fstat(fds[index + 1])
            if any((s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_mode) != (dev, ino, mode) for s in (linked, held)):
                raise ValueError('parent directory identity changed')
    finally:
        for fd in reversed(fds):
            os.close(fd)


def create_directory(path):
    path = Path(path)
    with parent_fd(path) as (fd, name):
        os.mkdir(name, 0o700, dir_fd=fd)
        value = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) or value.st_uid != os.geteuid() or stat.S_IMODE(value.st_mode) != 0o700:
            raise ValueError('private evidence directory required')
    return path


def write_new(path, data):
    if type(data) is not bytes:
        raise TypeError('evidence bytes required')
    with parent_fd(path) as (fd, name):
        leaf = os.open(name, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o600, dir_fd=fd)
        try:
            view = memoryview(data)
            while view:
                count = os.write(leaf, view)
                if count <= 0:
                    raise OSError('short evidence write')
                view = view[count:]
            _EVIDENCE_FSYNC(leaf)
            os.lseek(leaf, 0, os.SEEK_SET)
            digest = sha256()
            size = 0
            while chunk := os.read(leaf, 1 << 20):
                digest.update(chunk)
                size += len(chunk)
            if size != len(data) or digest.hexdigest() != sha256(data).hexdigest():
                raise ValueError('evidence write readback differs')
            observed = identity(os.fstat(leaf))
            if identity(os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)) != observed:
                raise ValueError('evidence name changed')
        finally:
            os.close(leaf)
        _EVIDENCE_FSYNC(fd)
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'identity': observed}


def write_json(path, value):
    return write_new(path, (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) + '\n').encode())


def read_file(path, maximum=None):
    with parent_fd(path) as (fd, name):
        before = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or (maximum is not None and before.st_size > maximum):
            raise ValueError('bounded regular evidence input required: ' + str(path))
        leaf = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_CLOEXEC, dir_fd=fd)
        try:
            if identity(os.fstat(leaf)) != identity(before):
                raise ValueError('input changed while opening')
            chunks = []
            remaining = before.st_size
            while remaining:
                chunk = os.read(leaf, min(1 << 20, remaining))
                if not chunk:
                    raise ValueError('short input read')
                chunks.append(chunk)
                remaining -= len(chunk)
            if identity(os.fstat(leaf)) != identity(before):
                raise ValueError('input changed while reading')
            if identity(os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)) != identity(before):
                raise ValueError('input name changed while reading')
        finally:
            os.close(leaf)
    return b''.join(chunks), identity(before)


@contextmanager
def _cold_evidence_input(path, maximum, expected_bytes=None):
    """Bound one immutable regular cold-evidence input by its actual size."""
    if type(maximum) is not int or maximum < 0:
        raise ValueError('nonnegative cold-evidence byte budget required')
    if expected_bytes is not None and (type(expected_bytes) is not int or expected_bytes < 0):
        raise ValueError('integer cold-evidence size required')
    with parent_fd(path) as (parent, name):
        before = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        if (not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_nlink != 1 or
                before.st_size > maximum or
                (expected_bytes is not None and before.st_size != expected_bytes)):
            raise ValueError('cold evidence must be regular, single-link and within its byte budget: '
                             + str(path) + '; size=' + str(before.st_size)
                             + '; maximum=' + str(maximum))
        leaf = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_CLOEXEC, dir_fd=parent)
        try:
            if identity(os.fstat(leaf)) != identity(before):
                raise ValueError('cold evidence changed while opening')
            yield leaf, identity(before)
            if (identity(os.fstat(leaf)) != identity(before) or
                    identity(os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)) != identity(before)):
                raise ValueError('cold evidence identity or name changed while reading')
        finally:
            os.close(leaf)


def observe_cold_evidence(path, maximum, *, expected_bytes=None, expected_sha256=None):
    """Read all actual bytes in fixed chunks, including an explicit EOF check."""
    with _cold_evidence_input(path, maximum, expected_bytes) as (leaf, before):
        digest = sha256()
        remaining = before['size']
        while remaining:
            chunk = os.read(leaf, min(1 << 20, remaining))
            if not chunk:
                raise ValueError('short cold evidence read')
            remaining -= len(chunk)
            digest.update(chunk)
        if os.read(leaf, 1):
            raise ValueError('cold evidence grew beyond its admitted size')
        actual = digest.hexdigest()
        if expected_sha256 is not None and actual != expected_sha256:
            raise ValueError('cold evidence SHA256 differs')
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': before['size'], 'sha256': actual, 'identity': before}


def copy_cold_evidence(source, destination, maximum, *, expected_bytes=None, expected_sha256=None):
    """Retain full bytes with bounded memory; failed partial output is preserved.

    This is evidence custody, not a product input/output limit. The source and
    new destination are held by descriptor, their complete byte hashes are
    joined, and every named link is rechecked before success can be returned.
    """
    with _cold_evidence_input(source, maximum, expected_bytes) as (incoming, before):
        with parent_fd(destination) as (parent, name):
            target = os.open(name, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,
                             0o600, dir_fd=parent)
            try:
                os.fchmod(target, 0o600)
                digest = sha256()
                remaining = before['size']
                while remaining:
                    chunk = os.read(incoming, min(1 << 20, remaining))
                    if not chunk:
                        raise ValueError('short cold evidence copy')
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    view = memoryview(chunk)
                    while view:
                        count = os.write(target, view)
                        if count <= 0:
                            raise OSError('short cold evidence write')
                        view = view[count:]
                if os.read(incoming, 1):
                    raise ValueError('cold evidence grew beyond its admitted size')
                _EVIDENCE_FSYNC(target)
                copied = identity(os.fstat(target))
                actual = digest.hexdigest()
                if (copied['size'] != before['size'] or copied['nlink'] != 1 or
                        copied['uid'] != os.geteuid() or stat.S_IMODE(copied['mode']) != 0o600):
                    raise ValueError('cold evidence destination identity differs')
                os.lseek(target, 0, os.SEEK_SET)
                readback = sha256()
                remaining = copied['size']
                while remaining:
                    chunk = os.read(target, min(1 << 20, remaining))
                    if not chunk:
                        raise ValueError('short cold evidence readback')
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                    readback.update(chunk)
                if (os.read(target, 1) or readback.hexdigest() != actual or
                        identity(os.fstat(target)) != copied or
                        identity(os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)) != copied):
                    raise ValueError('cold evidence retained bytes or name differ')
                if expected_sha256 is not None and actual != expected_sha256:
                    raise ValueError('cold evidence SHA256 differs')
                _EVIDENCE_FSYNC(parent)
            finally:
                os.close(target)
    return {'source': str(source), 'original_identity': before,
            'retained': {'path': str(destination), 'bytes': before['size'],
                         'sha256': actual, 'identity': copied},
            'stream_copy': {'chunk_bytes': 1 << 20, 'maximum_bytes': maximum,
                            'expected_bytes': expected_bytes, 'expected_sha256': expected_sha256,
                            'complete_source_and_destination_readback': True}}


def process_identity(pid):
    """Linux PID identity only; no assertion of a full process-tree owner."""
    try:
        raw = Path('/proc/' + str(pid) + '/stat').read_bytes()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    fields = raw[raw.rindex(b')') + 2:].split()
    return {'pid': int(pid), 'ppid': int(fields[1]), 'pgrp': int(fields[2]),
            'session': int(fields[3]), 'starttime': int(fields[19]), 'state': fields[0].decode('ascii')}


def descendants(pid):
    table = {}
    for entry in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if entry.name.isdecimal():
            try:
                observed = process_identity(int(entry.name))
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            if observed is not None:
                table[observed['pid']] = observed
    selected = []
    parents = {pid}
    while True:
        extra = [row for row in table.values() if row['ppid'] in parents and row['pid'] not in parents]
        if not extra:
            return selected
        selected.extend(extra)
        parents.update(row['pid'] for row in extra)


def child_usage():
    value = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    return {name: getattr(value, name) for name in
            ('ru_utime', 'ru_stime', 'ru_maxrss', 'ru_minflt', 'ru_majflt', 'ru_inblock', 'ru_oublock', 'ru_nvcsw', 'ru_nivcsw')}


def native_command(argv):
    return (isinstance(argv, (list, tuple)) and len(argv) >= 4 and
            all(isinstance(item, (str, os.PathLike)) for item in argv) and argv[-3] in OPERATIONS)


class _Call:
    def __init__(self, session, argv, wire, timeout, origin, kwargs):
        self.session = session
        self.index = len(session.calls)
        self.root = session.root / 'calls' / ('%05d' % self.index)
        self.test_id = session.test_id
        self.argv = None
        self.events = []
        self.flushed = 0
        self.process = None
        self.launch_attempted = False
        self.launch_completed = False
        self.launched_pid = None
        self.pid_identity = None
        self.pid_identity_error = None
        self.seen = {}
        self.returncode = None
        self.closed_observed = False
        self.record_errors = []
        self.origin = origin
        self.input = self.code = self.request = None
        self.root_created = self.request_written = self.preflight_complete = False
        self.preflight_stage = 'INITIALIZED'
        self.preflight_error = None
        # All fields used by summary/finish are initialized before the first
        # evidence operation.  A failed preflight is a real call attempt record,
        # not a launch, and must not erase the original unittest failure.
        session.calls.append(self)
        try:
            self.preflight_stage = 'DIRECTORY'
            create_directory(self.root)
            self.root_created = True
            self.preflight_stage = 'ARGUMENTS'
            self.argv = [os.fspath(v) for v in argv]
            if type(wire) is not bytes:
                raise TypeError('test native stdin must be exact bytes')
            self.preflight_stage = 'STDIN'
            self.input = write_new(self.root / 'stdin.offered.bin', wire)
            self.preflight_stage = 'EXECUTABLE_READ'
            executable = self.argv[-4]
            if executable.startswith('/proc/self/fd/'):
                source_fd = int(executable.rsplit('/', 1)[1])
                before = identity(os.fstat(source_fd))
                if not stat.S_ISREG(before['mode']) or before['size'] > 1 << 20:
                    raise ValueError('bounded sealed executable required')
                code = os.pread(source_fd, before['size'], 0)
                if len(code) != before['size'] or identity(os.fstat(source_fd)) != before:
                    raise ValueError('sealed executable changed')
            else:
                code, before = read_file(Path(executable).absolute(), 1 << 20)
            self.preflight_stage = 'EXECUTABLE_WRITE'
            self.code = write_new(self.root / 'executable.bin', code)
            self.request = {'schema': 'hepta.hia.publication-test-call.v1', 'ordinal': self.index,
                            'test_id': self.test_id, 'origin': origin, 'argv': self.argv,
                            'cwd': os.getcwd(), 'env': kwargs.get('env'), 'timeout': timeout,
                            'capture_output': kwargs.get('capture_output'),
                            'pass_fds': list(kwargs.get('pass_fds', ())),
                            'stdin': self.input, 'executable': self.code, 'executable_original_identity': before,
                            'stdin_scope': 'full bytes offered by the test; consumed byte count is not inferred',
                            'timeout_scope': 'unchanged original subprocess timeout, after evidence preflight'}
            self.preflight_stage = 'REQUEST_WRITE'
            write_json(self.root / 'request.json', self.request)
            self.request_written = self.preflight_complete = True
            self.preflight_stage = 'READY'
        except BaseException as exc:
            self.preflight_error = {'stage': self.preflight_stage, 'type': type(exc).__name__}
            try:
                self.preflight_error.update(message=str(exc), traceback=traceback.format_exc())
            except BaseException as rendering:
                self.preflight_error['rendering_error_type'] = type(rendering).__name__
            text = 'PREFLIGHT: ' + self.preflight_stage + ': ' + type(exc).__name__
            self.record_errors.append(text)
            session.errors.append('call %d %s' % (self.index, text))
            self.event('PREFLIGHT_EXCEPTION', failure=self.preflight_error)
            raise

    def event(self, kind, **values):
        # No filesystem I/O, payload hashing or /proc traversal occurs between
        # an original communicate timeout and the original caller's kill/wait.
        # These references are serialized only after the test's cleanups.
        row = {'kind': kind, 'monotonic_ns': time.monotonic_ns(), **values}
        self.events.append(row)

    def flush(self):
        while self.flushed < len(self.events):
            index = self.flushed
            row = dict(self.events[index])
            for name in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
                if name in row:
                    raw = row[name]
                    row[name] = None if raw is None else write_new(self.root / ('%03d-%s.bin' % (index, name)), raw)
            write_json(self.root / ('%03d-event.json' % index), row)
            self.events[index] = row
            self.flushed += 1

    def see_descendants(self):
        if self.process is not None:
            for row in descendants(self.process.pid):
                self.seen[(row['pid'], row['starttime'])] = row

    def summary(self):
        if self.process is not None:
            self.returncode = getattr(self.process, 'returncode', None)
            self.closed_observed = self.returncode is not None
        return {'ordinal': self.index, 'path': str(self.root), 'test_id': self.test_id,
                'request': str(self.root / 'request.json'), 'process': self.pid_identity,
                'launch_attempted': self.launch_attempted, 'launch_completed': self.launch_completed,
                'launched_pid': self.launched_pid, 'pid_identity_error': self.pid_identity_error,
                'descendants_seen': list(self.seen.values()), 'returncode': self.returncode,
                'direct_child_reaped_observed': self.closed_observed,
                'events': len(self.events), 'record_errors': self.record_errors,
                'preflight': {'stage': self.preflight_stage, 'complete': self.preflight_complete,
                              'root_created': self.root_created, 'request_written': self.request_written,
                              'error': self.preflight_error, 'stdin': self.input, 'executable': self.code,
                              'unwritten_request_data': None if self.request_written else self.request},
                'full_process_tree_cleanup_claimed': False}


def direct_child_custody_closed(row):
    """An absent identity cannot stand for a launch that never happened."""
    keys = {'launch_attempted', 'launch_completed', 'launched_pid', 'process',
            'pid_identity_error', 'returncode', 'direct_child_reaped_observed'}
    if not keys <= row.keys() or type(row['launch_attempted']) is not bool or type(row['launch_completed']) is not bool:
        return False
    if not row['launch_attempted']:
        return (row['launch_completed'] is False and row['launched_pid'] is None
                and row['process'] is None and row['pid_identity_error'] is None
                and row['returncode'] is None and row['direct_child_reaped_observed'] is False)
    observed = row['process']
    return (row['launch_completed'] is True and type(row['launched_pid']) is int and row['launched_pid'] > 0
            and type(observed) is dict and type(observed.get('pid')) is int
            and observed['pid'] == row['launched_pid'] and type(observed.get('starttime')) is int
            and observed['starttime'] >= 0 and row['pid_identity_error'] is None
            and type(row['returncode']) is int and row['direct_child_reaped_observed'] is True)


class _ObservedPopen(_REAL_POPEN):
    def __init__(self, call, *args, **kwargs):
        self._custody_call = call
        call.launch_attempted = True
        call.event('LAUNCH_BEGIN', usage=child_usage())
        try:
            super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException as exc:
            # A constructor exception may follow creation of an OS child.
            # Record any exposed PID, without new termination/wait behavior.
            pid = getattr(self, 'pid', None)
            if type(pid) is int and pid > 0:
                call.process = self
                call.launched_pid = pid
            call.event('LAUNCH_EXCEPTION', exception_type=type(exc).__name__, exception=repr(exc))
            raise
        call.process = self
        call.launch_completed = True
        call.launched_pid = self.pid
        try:
            call.pid_identity = process_identity(self.pid)
        except BaseException as exc:
            text = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
            call.pid_identity_error = text
            call.record_errors.append('PID_IDENTITY: ' + text)
            call.session.errors.append('call %d PID_IDENTITY: %s' % (call.index, text))
            call.event('PID_IDENTITY_EXCEPTION', exception_type=type(exc).__name__, exception=repr(exc),
                       launched_pid=call.launched_pid)
            raise
        if call.pid_identity is None:
            call.pid_identity_error = 'process_identity returned no identity after launch'
            call.record_errors.append('PID_IDENTITY: ' + call.pid_identity_error)
            call.session.errors.append('call %d PID_IDENTITY: %s' % (call.index, call.pid_identity_error))
        call.event('LAUNCH_RETURN', process=call.pid_identity)

    def communicate(self, input=None, timeout=None):
        call = self._custody_call
        call.event('COMMUNICATE_BEGIN', timeout=timeout,
                   input_argument_bytes=None if input is None else len(input))
        try:
            out, err = super().communicate(input=input, timeout=timeout)
        except BaseException as exc:
            call.event('COMMUNICATE_EXCEPTION', exception_type=type(exc).__name__, exception=repr(exc),
                       stdout=getattr(exc, 'output', None), stderr=getattr(exc, 'stderr', None),
                       returncode=self.returncode, usage=child_usage(), output_may_be_partial=True)
            raise
        call.event('COMMUNICATE_RETURN', stdout=out, stderr=err, returncode=self.returncode,
                   usage=child_usage(), output_may_be_partial=False)
        return out, err

    def kill(self):
        self._custody_call.event('ORIGINAL_CALLER_KILL_REQUEST')
        return super().kill()


class Session:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = create_directory(Path(root).absolute())
        for name in ('calls', 'fixtures', 'inputs'):
            create_directory(self.root / name)
        self.calls = []
        self.fixtures = []
        self.test_id = None
        self.tests = []
        self.errors = []
        self.runner = process_identity(os.getpid())
        self._run_hook = self.run
        write_json(self.root / 'START.json', {'schema': 'hepta.hia.publication-test-custody.v1',
                   'status': 'RUNNING', 'runner': self.runner, 'created_ns': time.time_ns(),
                   'native_operations': sorted(OPERATIONS), 'full_process_tree_owner_added': False})

    def install(self):
        global _ACTIVE
        if _ACTIVE is not None or subprocess.run is not _REAL_RUN:
            raise ValueError('one explicit publication test observer required')
        _ACTIVE = self
        subprocess.run = self._run_hook

    def restore(self):
        global _ACTIVE
        if subprocess.run is not self._run_hook:
            self.errors.append('subprocess.run observer was not restored by a test')
        subprocess.run = _REAL_RUN
        _ACTIVE = None

    def run(self, *popenargs, **kwargs):
        argv = popenargs[0] if popenargs else kwargs.get('args')
        if not native_command(argv):
            return _REAL_RUN(*popenargs, **kwargs)
        call = _Call(self, argv, kwargs.get('input', b''), kwargs.get('timeout'), 'subprocess.run', kwargs)
        original_popen = subprocess.Popen
        def launch(*args, **options):
            actual = args[0] if args else options.get('args')
            if [os.fspath(v) for v in actual] != call.argv:
                raise ValueError('observed Popen argv differs from original run')
            return _ObservedPopen(call, *args, **options)
        subprocess.Popen = launch
        try:
            result = _REAL_RUN(*popenargs, **kwargs)
        except BaseException as exc:
            call.event('RUN_EXCEPTION', exception_type=type(exc).__name__, exception=repr(exc),
                       stdout=getattr(exc, 'output', None), stderr=getattr(exc, 'stderr', None),
                       returncode=None if call.process is None else call.process.returncode)
            raise
        else:
            call.event('RUN_RETURN', returncode=result.returncode)
            return result
        finally:
            subprocess.Popen = original_popen

    def popen(self, argv, *, offered_input, **kwargs):
        if not native_command(argv):
            raise ValueError('explicit test Popen must be a native publication command')
        call = _Call(self, argv, offered_input, None, 'test direct Popen', kwargs)
        return _ObservedPopen(call, argv, **kwargs)

    def temporary_directory(self, prefix):
        # Preserve TemporaryDirectory's original filesystem, prefix and random
        # basename. Retention must not move the measured workload to RUNNER_TEMP.
        folder = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=prefix)).absolute()
        with parent_fd(folder) as (fd, name):
            value = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
            if not stat.S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) or value.st_uid != os.geteuid() or stat.S_IMODE(value.st_mode) != 0o700:
                raise ValueError('private original temporary directory required')
            observed = identity(value)
        self.fixtures.append({'path': str(folder), 'prefix': prefix, 'test_id': self.test_id,
                              'root_identity_at_creation': observed,
                              'allocation': 'stdlib tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix), no dir override'})
        write_json(self.root / ('fixture-%03d.json' % (len(self.fixtures) - 1)), self.fixtures[-1])
        return _RetainedDirectory(folder)

    def finish(self, result):
        self.flush_calls()
        rows = [call.summary() for call in self.calls]
        known_closed = all(direct_child_custody_closed(row) for row in rows)
        body = {'schema': 'hepta.hia.publication-test-custody.v1', 'runner': self.runner,
                'status': 'TESTS_PASS' if result.wasSuccessful() and not self.errors and known_closed else 'TESTS_FAIL_OR_CUSTODY_HOLD',
                'test_result_successful': result.wasSuccessful(), 'tests_run': result.testsRun,
                'tests': self.tests, 'calls': rows, 'fixtures': self.fixtures, 'errors': self.errors,
                'known_direct_children_reaped': known_closed,
                'original_timeouts_changed': False, 'full_process_tree_cleanup_claimed': False,
                'end_ns': time.time_ns()}
        write_json(self.root / 'RUN.json', body)
        return body

    def flush_calls(self):
        for call in self.calls:
            if call.flushed != len(call.events):
                try:
                    call.flush()
                except BaseException as exc:
                    text = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
                    call.record_errors.append(text)
                    self.errors.append('call %d evidence flush: %s' % (call.index, text))

def file_digests(root=ROOT):
    root = Path(root)
    # Include the complete Python seed package, not a hand-maintained subset
    # that can omit a transitively imported checker or native ABI dependency.
    paths = sorted(set(SOURCE_FILES) | {
        p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in (root / "hepta").rglob("*.py")
    })
    return {path: sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths}

    return declared
